How it works

When you save a bookmark, the AI analyzes the page content and automatically organizes it into the appropriate folder based on your existing bookmark structure.

Articles are sent to Instapaper. Other content is saved to Chrome bookmarks.

Security

API keys are stored in your browser's extension storage and synced across your Chrome devices. Use dedicated API keys with limited scope when possible.

Local AI Model (EmbeddingGemma-2) On-Device AI

Run Google's EmbeddingGemma-2 universal GGUF model directly on-device for high-precision, zero-latency vector embedding, cosine similarity matching, and bookmark sorting. Everything runs 100% locally with complete privacy — only embedding models supported, no cloud API keys, and no subscriptions.

EmbeddingGemma-2 (UD-Q4_K_XL)

GGUF UD-Q4_K_XL 768 Dims (Matryoshka to 256) Embedding Only ~168 MB Unsloth / Google
Checking status...

Universal on-device GGUF embedding model quantized by Unsloth. Produces 768-dimensional dense vector embeddings with optional Matryoshka dimension truncation (768 to 256 dimensions with L2 re-normalization) and cosine similarity ranking.

Instapaper Optional
When the AI detects a page as an article, it will be saved to Instapaper instead of added as a Chrome bookmark.
Leave blank if you haven't set a password.
Todoist Optional
Get your token from Todoist Settings
Things Optional
Add bookmarks as to-dos in the Things app (macOS/iOS). The option only appears in the popup when you're on a Mac or iOS device.
Readwise Optional
Save bookmarks to Readwise Reader. Get your access token from readwise.io/access_token.
Raindrop.io Optional
Save bookmarks to Raindrop.io with AI-generated tags. Create a test token at Raindrop.io Integrations.
Domain Rules Optional
Automatically save bookmarks from specific domains to a folder, skipping AI analysis. Use github.com to match all pages, or youtube.com/watch to match by path prefix.

Sorting Preferences

Configure how bookmarks in "To Sort" (Inbox) are analyzed, batched, and organized into folders.

Sorting preferences Optional
Number of bookmarks analyzed in a single AI prompt (default: 100, min: 5, max: 100).
How many batch requests to run simultaneously in parallel (default: 4, min: 1, max: 10). Higher values process faster.
Automatic Health Checks Optional
Runs a health check in the background on the selected schedule. Results appear in the Health Check page.
days without being opened
Chrome tracks when bookmarks were last visited. Bookmarks older than this threshold are flagged as stale.
